input.reply:
Thank you for the detailed report and reproduction. This is a real issue—`getNames()` in `packages/runner/src/utils/tasks.ts` lacks cycle detection in the suite chain traversal, causing an infinite loop and OOM when a cycle exists.

Your suggested fix using a `Set` to track visited suites is sound. The cycle can only be introduced by broken suite initialization logic elsewhere, but defensive protection in `getNames()` is essential since it's called from the error reporting path and must never hang.

The real-world impact (2-week hang, 839MB) confirms this needs a fix. Please open a PR with the cycle detection patch—ideally including a test case to prevent regression.
